notes: THE FEDERATION IS SEVERELY LOPSIDED BY CONSTRUCTION AND THAT IS THE MOST USEFUL THING ABOUT IT. Mandarin covers roughly two-thirds to three-quarters of the Han area and has about 990 million L1 speakers against the other seven combined at perhaps 400 million. A federation in which one member is larger than every other member put together is not a balanced union and cannot be written as one. DRAW IT AT ITS TRUE SIZE - do not balance the map.

domain_territory: Eastern Guangdong; Leizhou; with MIN-NAN REACHING TAIWAN AND HAINAN
sphere_territory: The Hokkien-speaking diaspora of Southeast Asia - OUT OF SCOPE
skinner_macroregion: Southeast Coast - THE STRONGEST AGREEMENT IN THE TABLE
notes: MIN IS FIVE LANGUAGES NOT ONE - Min-Bei; Min-Dong; Min-Zhong; Min-Nan and Pu-Xian are mapped separately. RECOMMENDATION: KEEP MIN AS ONE FEDERAL MEMBER. Splitting it five ways would give Fujian more representation than the entire north - the same tension Ribeiro's five Brasis created and it resolves the same way. Min is the only Sinitic branch that cannot be derived directly from Middle Chinese; in the western Fujian mountains adjacent villages can be mutually unintelligible. THE ONLY BRANCH THAT SPANS THE STRAIT - which is why region 9 Taiwan is contested.

core_territory: NONE - scattered interior pockets across the Guangdong-Fujian-Jiangxi borderlands
early_era_status: UNRESOLVED - Hakka has no territory in either era; the one member that cannot have been a state
notes: THE BEST STRUCTURAL FINDING IN THE SURVEY. HAKKA HAS NO MACROREGION AND CANNOT BE DRAWN UNDER THE WHOLE-SUBDIVISION RULE AT ALL. 44 million people occupying the hills where Guangdong; Fujian and Jiangxi meet - the interstices of three provinces and three macroregions in terrain nobody's lowland core wanted. The name means guest families. THIS IS WOODARD'S GREATER APPALACHIA EXACTLY. TWO WAYS TO HANDLE IT AND THE AUTHOR SHOULD PICK KNOWINGLY: either a NON-TERRITORIAL member of the Federation - a nation with representation and no province - or absorbed into Yue; Min and Gan with the loss recorded. DRAW AS SCATTERED HATCHED POCKETS - NOT as a solid region. The Hakka hills are also the obvious location for a separatist movement; a bandit country; or a partisan war.
